# Technical Context - Arcade Hub

Lang: en
Website: [https://menj.buzz/arcade/](https://menj.buzz/arcade/)
Last Updated: 2026-10-06

## Platform

- Static site, no CMS and no database
- Language: en
- Character Set: UTF-8

## Technology Stack

- HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript
- games.json drives the card grid
- Self-hosted WOFF2 fonts

## Developer Notes

- Each game lives in its own folder under /arcade/ and ships a game.json manifest.
- Colour schemes are CSS variables selected in a tabbed settings dialog.

## Data Feeds

- [Games list (JSON)](https://menj.buzz/arcade/games.json)
